relevance.why: Three of five (Ponytail, claude-mem, obsidian-skills) directly target Claude Code cost and context loss, the two biggest pain points for a time-poor solo founder. Two are media-gen skills that are off-topic.

implement_score.why: Try Ponytail and claude-mem on one project for a week and measure token spend. Both are GitHub installs. Skip the image/video skills unless making marketing assets.

verify: Ponytail 50% claim is measured on Haiku 4.5 over 12 tasks — does it hold on Fable/Opus with real codebases?
Is claude-mem maintained and safe (it stores all session observations locally; check what leaves the machine)?
